<a id="english"></a>
### English

> This release adds a unified transfer-and-sync workspace with safer scheduling, real-time monitoring, and quieter run history. It also improves SFTP browsing and narrow-pane controls while keeping existing tasks and sync baselines compatible.

#### Important additions

- Added a desktop-only SFTP automation manager for scheduled uploads, downloads, and saved folder-sync rules. Tasks persist independently from run history, can be started manually or by schedule, and continue while Terma is minimized as long as the application remains running.
- Unified transfers and folder sync into one “Transfer and sync tasks” list and create/edit form. Direction offers upload, download, or bidirectional; schedule offers one-time, recurring, Cron, and real-time modes. The backend still preserves ordinary-transfer versus safe-sync execution and existing sync baselines, while task order remains stable across refreshes and can be rearranged by drag or keyboard.
- Added safe execution safeguards: saved SSH connections, bounded retries, restart catch-up or skip policies, conflict copies, local-path and symlink checks, optional deletion propagation (off by default), successful source/two-sided baselines, and SHA-256 checks for same-sized files. Unchanged files are skipped while missing destinations are restored; zero-byte remote files are created correctly; failed desktop delivery no longer leaves staging folders behind; Web requests cannot access local-path automation APIs.
- Added a complete schedule and remote-folder experience: second, minute, hour, day, week, month, year, specified-time, countdown, half-hour, Cron, and real-time intervals; start-time support; live Cron validation with the next three execution times; and a left-aligned remote tree with root, expand/collapse, new-folder, and direct local/remote path actions. Internal `.` paths are hidden, half-hour slots stay inside their panel, and task cards and primary actions remain readable across themes.
- Added live monitoring and refresh behavior. Near-real-time sync checks remote changes about every 10 seconds, shows monitoring instead of a misleading next-sync timestamp, distinguishes scanning, enabled idle monitoring, and paused tasks, and refreshes the open task list automatically.
- Added per-task summary notifications and task-local run history. File-level and start notifications no longer flood the task center; enabled tasks send one summary with processed, transferred, deleted, skipped, conflicting, and failed counts, while folder sync is silent by default. History is paged at 100 entries, keeps 300 by default with a configurable cap, supports expandable details, clickable filters, and in-place clearing. Consecutive successful no-change checks merge into the latest summary with a streak count, while real transfer, delete, conflict, and failure entries remain separate.

#### Other improvements

- Improved SFTP directory browsing with a native directory channel, shared snapshots for search/sort/page operations, cancellation of stale requests, and safer mixed-encoding filename handling.
- Added visible left/right controls and edge fades for terminal shortcut buttons in narrow panes. Click, touch drag, mouse wheel, and keyboard scrolling remain available without page-wide horizontal overflow, with localized accessible labels.

#### Changes in this release

- No pull requests were merged after v1.6.4; all user-visible changes in this release were committed directly by the project maintainer.

**Full Changelog**: [v1.6.4...v1.7.0](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/compare/v1.6.4...v1.7.0)

<a id="简体中文"></a>
### 简体中文

> 本版新增统一的传输与同步工作区，提供更安全的调度、实时监控和更清爽的运行记录；同时改进 SFTP 浏览和窄屏操作，并保持已有任务与同步基线兼容。

#### 重要新增

- 新增仅桌面端可用的 SFTP 自动化管理器，支持定时上传、下载和可保存的文件夹同步规则。任务定义与运行记录分开持久化，可手动启动或按计划执行；只要 Terma 仍在运行，窗口最小化后也会继续调度。
- 将传输和文件夹同步合并为一个“传输与同步任务”列表及新建/编辑表单。方向提供上传、下载、双向，执行周期提供一次、各种周期、Cron 和实时；后端仍保留普通传输与安全同步的执行差异及已有同步基线，任务顺序不随刷新变化，并支持拖动或键盘调整。
- 新增安全执行保护：已保存 SSH 连接、有限重试、重启后补执行或跳过、冲突副本、本机路径与符号链接检查、默认关闭的删除传播、成功源端/双侧基线，以及同大小文件的 SHA-256 校验。未变化文件会跳过，缺失目标仍会补传；远端 0 字节文件会正确创建；桌面交付失败不再残留暂存目录；Web 请求不能访问包含本机路径的自动化 API。
- 完善执行周期和远程目录体验：支持秒、分钟、小时、天、周、月、年、指定时间、倒计时、整点/半点、Cron 和实时，并可设置开始时间；Cron 输入实时校验并展示最近三次执行时间；远程目录改为左对齐树状浏览，支持根目录、展开/收起、新建文件夹及直接打开本机/远程路径。根目录不再显示内部的 `.`，整点/半点时段保持在面板内，任务卡和主操作在各种主题下均清晰可读。
- 新增实时监控和刷新行为：近实时同步约每 10 秒检查远端变化，显示监控状态而不是误导性的下次执行时间，区分正在扫描、启用后的待机监控和已暂停任务，并自动刷新打开的任务列表。
- 新增按任务汇总通知和任务内运行记录。逐文件及开始通知不再填满通用任务中心；启用通知的任务每轮只发送一条汇总处理、传输、删除、跳过、冲突和失败数量的通知，文件夹同步默认静默。运行记录每页 100 条，默认最多保留 300 条并可调整上限，支持展开明细、点击筛选和在当前窗口清空；连续成功且无文件变化的检查会合并为最新摘要并显示连续次数，真实传输、删除、冲突和失败仍单独保留。

#### 其他优化

- 改进 SFTP 目录浏览：使用原生目录通道，搜索、排序和分页共享一次快照，过期请求会取消，并提高混合编码文件名处理的安全性。
- 窄屏终端快捷按钮被隐藏时新增可见的左右滚动按钮和边缘渐隐提示；点击、触控横滑、鼠标滚轮和键盘滚动均可使用，不会造成整页横向溢出，并补齐本地化无障碍名称。

#### 本次变更

- v1.6.4 之后没有合并 Pull Request；本版所有用户可见变化均由项目维护者直接提交。
